d: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Rep. Madeleine Dean, a member of the House Foreign Affairs Committee that will question Jensen Huang behind closed doors on Dec. 1, says his return to Nvidia raises serious concerns over national security and corporate governance. Marc Short, former chief of staff to Vice President Mike Pence, says congressional scrutiny of Jensen Huang is unlikely to end with his December appearances, predicting Democrats will revisit the Nvidia controversy after taking control of Congress in January.
